questions.question: What was Israel's concern after the war?
options: That a great and terrible famine would starve the whole of the nation
That the tribe of Benjamin would die out for lack of wives
That the people would soon demand a king to rule them
That a long drought would ruin all of the coming harvest
questions.answer: That the tribe of Benjamin would die out for lack of wives

questions.question: How did the surviving Benjamites get wives?
options: They bought wives from the Moabites
They took wives from Jabesh-gilead and Shiloh
They brought wives back from Egypt
They were given wives by the Philistines
questions.answer: They took wives from Jabesh-gilead and Shiloh

questions.question: The book of Judges ends with the refrain that everyone did what was right in his own eyes.
The book ends, "Everyone did what was right in his own _____."
Wives were provided for Benjamin from Jabesh-gilead and from _____.
